en: Tomorrow morning I will get up.
explain: _surgam_ is 1st person singular (future tense) of _surgō_: the ending already says “I”, so Latin needs no separate word for it.

Crās māne surgētis.
_surgētis_ is 2nd person plural (future tense) of _surgō_ (“you all will get up”), but here you need 1st person singular (future tense): _surgam_.
Crās māne surgēs.
_surgēs_ is 2nd person singular (future tense) of _surgō_ (“you will get up”), but here you need 1st person singular (future tense): _surgam_.
